episodeTitle.en: A behind-the-scenes interview with Lenny Rachitsky on building his newsletter and podcast
episodeTitle.zh: Lenny Rachitsky关于如何打造新闻通讯和播客的幕后访谈

guestBioOfficial.en: People have been asking me to sit on the other side of the mic for a long time. With my wife’s debut children’s book, Charts for Babies, coming out next month, we figured: why not do it together? What followed was one of the most honest conversations I’ve had on this podcast. Michelle asked things no one else would think to ask—and many things I’ve never shared publicly. You’ll hear about the specific moments that pushed me to start the newsletter, how I think about quality and iteration, what most stresses me out, and the scariest moment of my life. This was so fun, and so special, and I hope you like it. *We discuss:*
guestBioOfficial.zh:
很久以来，人们一直邀请我坐到麦克风的另一边。随着我妻子创作的儿童读物《宝宝图表》下个月出版，我们想：何不一起做呢？接下来的，是我在这个播客上进行过的最坦诚的对话之一。米歇尔问了一些别人想不到的问题——还有许多我从未公开分享过的内容。你会听到那些促使我创办新闻通讯的具体时刻，我如何看待质量和迭代，最让我焦虑的事情，以及我生命中最可怕的时刻。这次访谈非常有趣，也很特别，希望你们会喜欢。  
*我们讨论了：*

title.zh: Lenny Rachitsky关于如何打造新闻通讯和播客的幕后访谈

summary.en: Michelle describes the surreal moment she received the message "I have wisdom to share" that launched her newsletter, now over a million subscribers. She talks about turning anxiety and overthinking into accessible, illustrated essays. The episode is a warm, creative conversation about building an audience by being genuinely yourself.
summary.zh: 米歇尔描述了她收到"我有智慧要分享"这一讯息、从而开启新闻通讯的奇妙时刻——如今订阅已超百万。她谈到如何把焦虑与过度思考变成易懂的插图随笔。本期是一场温暖的创意对话，关于如何以真实的自己做大受众。
